items.title: Researchers found AI agents barely use the memories you give them
items.why: Across 8,000 coding tasks, most memories agents received were irrelevant or simply ignored - temper agent-memory hype.

items.title: Karpathy built an algorithm-free YouTube clone with Claude in 2 hours
items.why: 6,454 videos ranked by real Hacker News praise, not an algorithm - a weekend-sized template for your own curation tool.

items.title: A Postgres bug let ordinary SQL features forge a code-execution exploit
items.why: No parser bug needed, just a mislabeled aggregate type - a reminder that privilege checks must verify, never trust, declarations.

items.title: An ESP32 board turned into a pocket Ethernet network tester
items.why: One cheap board now reports link status, pings, and sniffs DHCP/LLDP - a buildable diagnostic tool for your own network tinkering.

items.title: bpftrace one-liners that diagnose Linux latency without restarting anything
items.why: Live syscall counts and scheduler-latency histograms from one command - try it on any box you can sudo into today.

items.title: Mo's algorithm: the sqrt-decomposition trick for queries a segment tree can't merge
items.why: Handles offline range queries like 'mode in this range' that segment trees choke on - a real interview and Codeforces differentiator.

items.title: The 'if X, then Y' planning trick that reliably boosts follow-through
items.why: Decades of research show pre-scripting your response to tough moments beats winging it - rehearse your hardest interview moments this way.

items.title: A stress hormone reshapes which memories your brain locks in, Yale finds
items.why: Cortisol sharpened emotion-memory coordination for charged moments in an fMRI study - early evidence, not license to cram anxious.

items.title: Protein supplements add real but modest strength gains on top of lifting
items.why: A 23-trial meta-analysis found about 2.6kg more on bench and 7.4kg more on squat, strongest in the first 12 weeks - timing beats hype.

items.title: An Indian chip startup's networking SoC passed first-silicon test, no respin
items.why: VIHAAN's broadband chip worked right out of the fab on its first try - a real engineering win, not just another funding headline.
items.source: Electronics For You (on Aheesa's VIHAAN chip)
